# Pull Request Description

Please include a summary of the work you completed and which task this work is for. 

Make sure the title of your PR follows the following format: <assignment-name>: Task <task-number> - <short-description-of-work>

Ex: GP1: Task 2 - Added RGB an Depth Camera Nodes

# Testing Evidence

If applicable, please include screenshots or other evidence of your change working successfully.

- [ ] Verified change follows the assignments best practices
- [ ] There are no build errors associated with my change
- [ ] I've reviewed the ***Common Mistakes*** section of the assignment and made sure to avoid them.

# AI Use Disclosure

If applicable, please list how you used AI for this change. This is the disclosure note from the course syllabus: *Disclose in the project README: name the tool, describe how it was used. Two or three sentences per team member.*

We will use the disclosure statements in each PR and add them to the final `report.pdf` that's submitted for each assignment.
